info.title: XUI platform and node API
info.description: Development platform with accounts, staff roles, shared rate limits, verified STARTTLS mail, immutable purchase snapshots, node access, durable metering, subscriptions and transactional events. Opt-in Alipay RSA2 page pay, WeChat Pay API v3 Native and classic Epay MD5 merchant adapters support verified notifications and atomic fulfillment. Real merchant acceptance, refunds and full statement reconciliation remain pending.

post.summary: Staff: replace identity and issue enrollment token
post.description: Immediately invalidates old enrollment and Agent credentials, clears heartbeat and observed version, and permits a revoked node to enroll again. Requires permission nodes.write. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: revoke node identity
post.description: Rejects subsequent control requests. Does not terminate existing proxy connections. Requires permission nodes.write. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Enroll a node using its temporary token
post.description: No browser Origin required. Within token lifetime, retry with the same Agent credential is idempotent; reuse with a different credential returns 409. Invalid, expired or revoked enrollment returns 401. Rate limited.

get.summary: Read authenticated node’s entitlement-filtered desired state and authorization lease
get.description: Active current periods only; future, expired and exhausted periods are excluded. A stable content digest keeps versions unchanged for lease-only renewals; authorization changes advance the version.

post.summary: Report configuration observation and liveness
post.description: No browser Origin required. Invalid identity returns 401; stale/ahead revision or concurrent identity revocation returns 409. Does not certify proxy readiness.

get.summary: Staff: read node configuration without credentials
get.description: Requires permission nodes.read. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: replace TLS bindings and explicit account allowlist
post.description: Configuration is audited and version checked. Invalid users, duplicate IDs/ports, unsupported protocols or invalid certificate references are rejected atomically. Valid writes advance desired revision and mark application pending. Requires permission nodes.write. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Report actual Xray configuration application result
post.description: Uses node Bearer identity, no browser Origin. 409 on stale/unobserved revision or revoked identity. Failed reports preserve the previously applied revision and cannot mark the new snapshot applied.

post.summary: Commit immutable usage evidence and charge its original entitlement periods

400.description: Invalid fields, counter arithmetic, or sampling interval

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked node identity

403.description: Binding/user/period was not historically authorized for this node

409.description: Batch content conflict, reused core sequence, or debit overflow

post.description: Node Bearer identity only, no browser Origin. Same node/batch ID and canonical content returns the same acknowledgement without charging again. Changed content or reuse of node/core/sequence returns 409. Unissued historical ownership returns 403. All items, raw up+down byte debits and evidence commit in one transaction; overage is recorded rather than clamped. Historical expired periods are accepted only within issued authorization history, with 30 seconds of clock/measurement tolerance. Revoked identities return 401. Agent must verify acknowledged batch ID and digest before deleting its local outbox entry.

post.summary: Generate a replacement subscription token; old URL immediately invalid
post.description: Replaces own subscription token atomically with audit. Only the SHA-256 digest is stored. Old token URLs fail after rotation; already imported proxy credentials remain unchanged.

post.summary: Revoke only subscription access; imported proxy credentials remain valid
post.description: Revokes own subscription download token and records audit. Imported proxy credentials remain valid until separately rotated or authorization removed.

post.summary: Rotate own proxy credentials across all granted nodes
post.description: Rotates own VLESS/Trojan credentials across granted nodes atomically, advances desired node revisions and records audit. Other users and subscription token remain unchanged. Old credentials stop working after node reconciliation.

get.summary: Read own subscription status without the token
Get authorized published endpoints using a subscription token
get.description: Bearer URL without Web Cookie. Only currently active non-revoked unexhausted entitlements, manual allowlist or purchased enabled node-group membership, opt-in publication, fresh heartbeat, applied revision and unexpired issued authorization are eligible. Pending/stale/revoked nodes excluded. URI/Base64 may be empty; structured formats reject traffic when empty. No direct fallback. Cache-Control:no-store and Referrer-Policy:no-referrer. Per-IP limit60/min; invalid or revoked token401.

get.summary: Staff: read node groups, nodes and versioned plan mappings
get.description: Operational group membership and future-order plan catalog mappings. Existing orders retain their group snapshot. Requires permission access.read. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: create an operational node group
post.description: Validates all member nodes; creates group, membership, audit and node_group.changed event atomically. Empty membership is allowed. Requires permission access.write. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: replace group members and enabled state
post.description: Optimistic revision check409. Changes affect current purchased-group entitlements in plan mode. Event targets old/new member union; manual allowlists remain independent. Requires permission access.write. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: replace groups for future orders
post.description: Plan row locked against order creation. Validates group IDs and current access revision. Existing paid and unpaid orders retain their captured groups. Audit and plan.access_changed event commit atomically. Requires permission access.write. Production also requires a verified account email.

get.description: Processed means control-plane delivery completed. Poll node read/applied versions separately. Failed events back off, dead-letter after5 failures. Requires permission events.read. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: requeue a failed unfinished event
post.description: Clears current failure count/error/dead-letter marker and makes event ready now; records audit. Processed events or ordinary never-failed pending events409. Missing event404. Requires permission events.retry. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Staff: revoke an entitlement period
post.description: Revocation excludes both manual and plan authorization. Business state, audit and entitlement.revoked event commit atomically. Repeated revoke200 without duplicate event. Does not refund or reschedule periods; no restore endpoint. Requires permission entitlements.revoke. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Request account email verification
post.description: Authenticated. Empty JSON body. Returns 202 after queueing; already verified returns 200. Verify token expires after24 hours. Replaces earlier unused verification token and cancels pending old mail.

post.summary: Consume a one-time email verification token
post.description: Explicit submission only. Returns400 for invalid, expired or consumed tokens. Does not create a session.

post.summary: Request password recovery
post.description: For any syntactically valid email, known and unknown accounts have identical202 status and body. Known accounts queue a30-minute, single-use reset token. Rate limited by direct peer IP and normalized email.

post.summary: Reset password and revoke all account sessions
post.description: Valid reset token required. Password is12–72 UTF-8 bytes. Invalid, consumed or expired token returns400. Increments account security version, revokes sessions and all unused reset tokens. Does not log in or mark email verified.

post.summary: Change password and revoke all account sessions
post.description: Requires current password and a different new password. Revokes all sessions and unused reset tokens. Caller must log in again.

get.summary: Development only: own active account mail
get.description: Authenticated current mailbox only, latest10 pending messages whose token is active. Production returns404; development anonymous request returns401. Response includes sensitive test links.
Requires users.read (admin or support). Includes no password hashes, session or account tokens. Requires permission users.read. Production also requires a verified account email.

post.summary: Admin: change an existing account role
post.description: Requires users.roles. Role changes invalidate all target sessions and create an audit record. Browser cannot demote its own administrator or the final administrator;409 on either conflict. Unknown target404. Requires permission users.roles. Production also requires a verified account email.

First creation permanently pins one provider and stable merchant payment ID; different-provider retry returns409. Channel disabled404; provider creation failure502; per-peer10/minute and per-user5/minute limits apply independently to creation and sync. A paid callback arriving before the checkout response cannot be downgraded by that response.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Business order ID owned by the current account.

post.description: For Alipay and WeChat, verifies signed query responses and exact payment ID/amount/currency before atomic fulfillment. Classic Epay api.php has no authenticated response contract; this adapter does not call it or settle from unsigned JSON and returns502 until a valid signed notify is processed. Pending verified results preserve the intent. Verified email required in production; separate shared peer/user sync limit10/5 per minute. Already paid intents return their stored state.

200.description: Provider acknowledgement: plain success for Alipay/Epay; SUCCESS JSON for WeChat. Returned only after verified notification processing and, for paid notifications, successful atomic database commit.

400.description: Rejected signature/data or transient processing failure. Plain fail or WeChat FAIL JSON. No successful acknowledgement on database failure.

404.description: Rejected signature/data or transient processing failure. Plain fail or WeChat FAIL JSON. No successful acknowledgement on database failure.

500.description: Rejected signature/data or transient processing failure. Plain fail or WeChat FAIL JSON. No successful acknowledgement on database failure.

get.description: Independent provider authentication; no browser session or Origin required. Body/query maximum64KiB. Valid paid notifications bind provider, merchant payment ID, transaction ID, integer amount and CNY currency before one atomic fulfillment. Replays are idempotent; transaction/order rebinding is rejected. Browser return parameters never settle. Classic Epay GET notification only; other adapters reject GET. Duplicate parameter values are rejected.

post.summary: Verify signed payment provider notification
post.description: Independent provider authentication; no browser session or Origin required. Body/query maximum64KiB. Valid paid notifications bind provider, merchant payment ID, transaction ID, integer amount and CNY currency before one atomic fulfillment. Replays are idempotent; transaction/order rebinding is rejected. Browser return parameters never settle. Alipay/Epay accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded without query parameters; WeChat accepts its signed/encrypted JSON notification and requires Wechatpay verification headers.

schema.description: Alipay RSA2 or Epay MD5 signed parameters; duplicate keys rejected.

nodeBearer.description: Independent node identity. Does not grant access to Web APIs.

permissions.description: Server-computed permissions used for staff navigation; each request is still authorized independently.

name.description: Trimmed nonempty node name, at most 100 UTF-8 bytes.

enrollment_token.description: Only returned on creation/rotation. Expires in 15 minutes.

agent_token.description: Random client-generated credential. Persist privately before enrollment for lost-response recovery.

lease_expires_at.description: No later than 60 seconds from snapshot creation or earliest authorized entitlement end. Agent kills its proxy when this lease expires without renewal.

observed_revision.description: Version read by the Agent, not an assertion that a proxy core applied it. Must be monotonic and no higher than desired_revision.

server_name.description: Certificate SAN hostname; verified by the Agent.

certificate.description: Local certificate basename. Reads <reference>.crt and <reference>.key from operator-configured certificate directory; no private keys in control protocol.

users.description: Manual-mode registered-account allowlist. Must be [] in plan mode. Current non-revoked, unexhausted entitlements are required in either mode. Production additionally requires verified account email.

public_host.description: Opt-in subscription destination hostname or literal IP; not the listen address. Empty with public_port=0 means unpublished.

public_port.description: Client-facing destination port, supports external TLS/LB port 443. Must accompany public_host.

access_mode.description: Missing/empty preserves manual allowlist. Plan mode derives active users from the purchased entitlement group snapshot and current enabled group membership; users must be []. Each mode still caps effective users at100.

revision.description: GET returns current desired revision; POST requires that exact revision or returns 409.

bindings.description: Complete replacement. Empty list stops the proxy. IDs and ports must be unique within the node.

credential.description: VLESS UUID or Trojan random hex secret. Only returned to the authenticated node.

server_name.description: Certificate SAN hostname; verified by the Agent.

certificate.description: Local certificate basename. Reads <reference>.crt and <reference>.key from operator-configured certificate directory; no private keys in control protocol.

instance_id.description: Unique core process instance on success; stopped for empty applied configuration; empty on failure.

AppliedState.description: Applied requires empty error_code and a valid instance_id. Failed requires a nonempty error_code and empty instance_id. Only the current desired revision already observed by the node is accepted.

UsageItem.description: Delta raw bytes attributed to one issued binding/user/entitlement. At least one direction must be positive; no duplicate attribution tuple within a batch. All additions must fit signed int64.

UsageBatch.description: Immutable batch; node identity is inferred from Bearer authorization. Positive sampling interval no longer than two minutes; end no more than 30 seconds in future. The shared JSON body limit is 64 KiB. Sequence is unique within node/core instance. UTC-normalized typed JSON including item order defines content digest.

token.description: Returned once. Server stores only SHA-256 hash.

name.description: Trimmed name, max100 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.
Trimmed name, max100 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.

revision.description: Current plans.access_revision from access overview. Stale writes409.

attempt_count.description: Current failed-attempt count, reset by an authorized retry.

last_error.description: Empty or sanitized failure code, not raw database detail.

processed_at.description: Control-plane delivery completed, not a claim that the Agent/core applied it.

body.description: Sensitive account action link; development mode and current mailbox only.

id.description: Stable merchant out_trade_no, distinct from the business order ID.

checkout_url.description: Empty before checkout creation or after an early paid notification. Sensitive signed payment link; HTTPS redirect or weixin QR content.

transaction_id.description: Verified provider transaction reference, present after payment.
